name: princy-hear-speech-rehab
description: Website for Princy Hear and Speech Rehab — speech therapy, audiology and stroke rehabilitation clinic

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.render-build: npm run db:generate && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w client
scripts.render-start: npm run db:deploy && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
